lastCompletedStory.title: Planner carries type from the issue into the PRD (both planner agent copies)

nextStoryContext: US-005 (composePrTitle emits <type>: <text> (CAM-<N>)) is next. The PRD now carries a top-level `type` field (defaults to 'feat', copied from the issue by the planner per US-004; the issue's own `type` is optional per US-001/US-002/US-003). Find composePrTitle (grep found it in src/release/pr-body.ts and used from src/release/ship-pr.ts / src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts) and change its title format to prefix with `<type>: ` derived from prdSnapshot.type (defaulting to 'feat' when the PRD lacks the field, for PRDs authored before this story). Do not touch the issue schema or planner again; this story is PRD-consumption only. After this, US-006 (ship-pr GitHub label) reads the same type value.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure Markdown edit to the two subagent-planner.md schema/instruction copies (added a top-level `type` field to the PRD output schema + copy-from-issue/default-feat instruction) and vendor re-embed; no external library API was exercised.
